What we offer

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Sunset and sea views

68 Google reviews mention the sunset views and 18 the sea view. The photos show the garden terrace above the coast.

Cocktails and cold drinks

80 reviews mention the cocktails. Guests write about a cocktail menu with plenty of interesting combinations and a passion fruit daiquiri.

From the grill

Guests mention the salmon, the pork chop, the calamari, the chicken souvlaki with tzatziki and the sea bass.

From the garden and the coast

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

A relaxed garden

One guest describes a relaxed garden with plenty of tree shade, giant cacti and ocean views, a good break after exploring the coastal caves.

Friendly service

One guest writes that the service was amazing, and another calls it perfect.

Easy to reach by car

One guest notes that there is plenty of parking.
